attrs.note: datasheet - material, colour, the mounting hardware, the two pass-through holes, the detachable cover and the 2.87 in finger duct are the specification table of the finger duct datasheet; RoHS and ISO 9001 are its Standards Compliance list.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger tips along the bottom as along the top, and the side view draws two equal walls; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Reference Guide table of the same datasheet gives CMH-SFD2U per cable type at 30 per cent and 100 per cent fill, and notes that the copper figures are theoretical, for reference only. The figure stated is the Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm row, as for CMH-SFD1U.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. The datasheet table gives 88.5 x 482.6 x 87 mm (3.48 x 19 x 3.43 in), and the front view dimensions 3.48 in [88.5mm]; the 89 in an older listing is that figure rounded, and 88.5 is taken for the ears. The ears are the ends of the moulded base plate, five holes each, and are not drawn; the duct between them is the CMH-SFD1U's 433, 24.8 mm of ear each end. Its 86.5 is the side view across the two finger walls, 3.4 in [86.5mm], with 2.8 in [71.5mm] between them; the front view reads the walls 2.5 and 2.0 mm inside the ear edges, 1 mm each side. `depth` STATES THE VENDOR OVERALL 87, the base 11.3 behind the plane of the ears and the fingers and cover in front of it.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn in CMH-SFD1U's shades, the cover a little lighter than the duct.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted. The front view of the datasheet draws the duct with the cover off - the two rows of finger tips end-on and the pass-through holes at the back of the channel. The finger walls are placed 1.2 inside the top and bottom of the duct, as on CMH-SFD1U, 7.3 thick, which leaves 69.5 between them: the front view reads 68.5 between the finger tips and the side view 71.5 between the walls' outer faces. The `duct` guide is that 69.5 over the full width of the duct.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the fingers stand 60 mm in front of the mounting plane and the base 11.3 behind it (the top view), as on CMH-SFD1U, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger walls, run across the rack; finger pitch and gap are the top view figures above.

left.note: drawing - the side view of CMH-SFD2U: the base, the two finger walls with 71.5 between them, and the hooked tips the cover clips to, drawn as the cover lips over them. The duct is open at both ends, and nothing is built across them.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. FS publishes one datasheet for CMH-SFD1U, CMH-SFD2U and CMH-DFD1U (Horizontal Cable Managers with Finger Duct), with a front view and a top and side view of each, inch dimensions with millimetres in brackets. Its embedded raster of the CMH-SFD2U front view is 5.91 px/mm across the 482.6 and 5.90 down the 88.5, so it is orthographic. The top view of CMH-SFD2U is the CMH-SFD1U top view line for line (the same twelve slots, 1.32 in [33.6mm] pitch label, 0.63 in [16mm] gap, 2.36 in [60mm] fingers and 0.47 in [12mm] base): the 2U part is the 1U part made taller, not deeper, and its fingers are the CMH-SFD1U fingers.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the base with the two pass-through holes of the front view, 75 x 37.5, 172 apart, 322 over both, centred. The straight-on render of the back (gallery image 5) confirms two holes, the fingers seen through them, and a round boss in the middle. The back is built as five plates round the two holes, sunk 0.05 inside the rear face, as CMH-SFD1U 0.1.2 builds its back.

rear-not-drawn.note: drawing - the boss in the middle of the back reads as a vendor mark and is not drawn; the ribs on the back of the base are not drawn.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT, NOT A BOX, built as CMH-SFD1U is: the base plate on the front view as a well 75.5 deep whose floor is open at the two pass-through holes, the two rows of fingers standing in it, the cover in it across the finger tips, which lifts off and opens the channel, and the back of the base closed by plates sunk just inside the rear, top, bottom and side faces. The channel and its two ends are open air.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 7.3 is the finger wall of CMH-SFD1U; the CMH-SFD2U side view reads (86.5 - 71.5) / 2 = 7.5 a wall, within its line weight of the same moulding.

top.note: drawing - the top view, rear at y=0, drawn as CMH-SFD1U's because the datasheet's two top views are the same drawing: the base 11.3 deep behind the ear plane, then the finger wall, then the cover from 72 to the front; twelve slots on a 34.1 pitch (the drawing, not the 33.6 label, as CMH-SFD1U settles it), 16 wide, each narrowing to a 4 mm neck under the cover.
